newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: EU agrees mandate for air talks with E.Europe.
newsitem.headline: EU agrees mandate for air talks with E.Europe.

text.p: European Union transport ministers agreed on Thursday to begin talks with ten central and east European countries intended to lead to a 25-country single market for civil aviation.
"It's through. There was no discussion," an Austrian diplomat said in reference to a European Commission mandate to begin talks with EU membership hopefuls from the former Warsaw Pact countries.

Talks, which are not expected before early next year, are to involve the 15-country EU in negotiations with Bulgaria, the Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Poland, Romania, Slovakia and Slovenia.

The aim is to replace the current web of bilateral aviation agreements across the region with a single framework, bringing the EU applicants' safety and technical standards into line with EU ones whilst liberalising traffic rights at the same time.
